idea: Mutapixels is a NEP-171 NFT collection where each pixel is also a small on-chain account. Minting seeds 15% of the price into a per-token vault; every mutation pays the token a 20% royalty, anyone can feed a pixel NEAR or $MUT, and only the current holder can withdraw. Sell the NFT and the vault, earnings history and holder-only lounge move with it. The contract enforces ownership at call time, approvals never grant vault access, and a MUT payout that fails after a sale is restored to the new holder. A NEP-413 signed-message gate with a live ownership re-check protects the holder page. $MUT trades in a real Ref Finance simple pool; the /ref page executes the swap natively against the Ref exchange contract, bypassing Ref's frontend RPC. The demo is on NEAR testnet; the repo includes 24 contract tests, a threat model, and a public renderer path.
